text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing it! Let's train!
Weight training, sprinting—bring on whatever you've got!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "L-E-T-'S  D-O  T-H-I-S!!"

After reaffirming the Mile CS Nambu Hai as her goal,
Espoir City's motivation burned even brighter.

I open the "Strongest Umamusume" notebook...
and look for the right training for her.
Her regimen for today will be—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Line up those hurdles!
I'll clear every single one without knocking them down!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
We're at the beach, you know?!
You can do hurdle practice anytime,
not just at training camp!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Combinations, huh...?

"Hurdle running requires jumping while running,
making it a workout that demands intense core awareness."

And when running on the beach, core strength is crucial.
If your feet get caught in the sand, your stride will falter.
In other words—
choice_data_list: With just this one routine, you can stimulate your core twice as much.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Is she a genius...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Man, the strongest Umamusume really is built different...!
Coming up with a training method like that...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Urah! Orah! Oryah!!
(BAM! BAM! BAM!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Aaargh~! I'll jump cleanly next time~~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... so hooot...
I'm exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Crouching...?
choice_data_list: First, put both hands on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?
...Like this?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
This is a track-and-field start!
We don't use this in Umamusume races, do we?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...So you were doing it after all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Does the "strongest Umamusume"
really enjoy weird training like this...?
choice_data_list: And it'll be effective for your running too.
And it'll be effective for your running too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? This?
With a single swing of her right leg, she tears through the sand. Espoir City's right leg snap is her trump card that shines on dirt tracks.
choice_data_list: Even at the start, I want to push off with that right leg.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Getting into the habit of
starting off with your right leg, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaalright, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... so hooot...
I'm exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship Nambu Hai is just around the corner, after all.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make sure we take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Say what you just said one more time.
choice_data_list: Let's take first place in the Nanbu Hai?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hell nooo!
Not that one!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...What you said during training earlier.
I'm gonna take notes."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there might be things
I can teach Falco again."
It was an attitude of wanting to "learn."

Rather than simply completing the routine before her,
she is now facing her training from
a completely different angle—...
choice_data_list: Sounds good! I'm free for an hour after this anyway!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!? I'm not gonna drag this out!
Just get it over with already!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaargh!
Don't look at me with sparkling eyes!
Do! Not! Get! Motivated! Stooooop it!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Because you're so damn ANNOYING--!!
